## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `go test ./...` passes.
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing, and `go vet ./...` passes.
- [ ] New exported identifiers have doc comments.
- [ ] A release note fragment is added, or the change needs none ([CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#release-notes)).
- [ ] Breaking changes, if any, are explained above.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
